perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Iron Grip
perks.desc: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of reload speed.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.desc: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.desc: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Iron Grip
perks.desc: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of reload speed.

perks.name: Iron Gaze
perks.desc: Massively improves weapon target acquisition at the cost of weapon range.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.desc: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.

notes: Recommended MW: Charge Time Recommended Mod: Targeting. Use with a Cascade Point or Harmony weapon. The idea here is to quickly swap to this and secure a Backup Plan kill, then you'll have 100 handling to swap back to your primary and have 100 handling there as well. Should fire extremely fast with all the charge time perks, and you'll still 4 bolt any resil. tags:god-pvp,pvp,controller

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. High-Impact(960) Kinetic Sidearm Primary Ammo. "In PvE there isn’t a lot to say about Wizened Rebuke. No Reservoir Burst and no reload perk gives this utility next to zero. Don’t use it."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. High-Impact(960) Kinetic Sidearm Primary Ammo. "In order to compete with Rapid-Fire fusions and Precision Frame fusions you’re going to either need to pre-charge with Under-Pressure and High-Impact Reserves or go all in for Backup Plan. This will bring the charge time down to 600ms while keeping the damage per bolt at 51 and maintaining the four bolt kill."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Range. High-Impact(960) Kinetic Sidearm Primary Ammo. "In order to compete with Rapid-Fire fusions and Precision Frame fusions you’re going to either need to pre-charge with Under-Pressure and High-Impact Reserves or go all in for Backup Plan. This will bring the charge time down to 600ms while keeping the damage per bolt at 51 and maintaining the four bolt kill."

[YeezyGT's S18] [MW: Charge] "Wizened Rebuke finds itself with a few high-Stability options, such as Iron Grip, Heating Up / Under Pressure. Aim to get that Charge Time down as much as you can, and look to land bursts at ranges you have absolutely no business landing."

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I absolutely loved using my firmly planted and tap the trigger Wizened Rebuke back in the Forsaken era of Seasons 6 and 7. With the fusion changes I would highly recommend cleaning up the recoil direction to make sure that you have the easiest time controlling the burst. For PvE similar to Riptide you will want vorpal weapon for the best success. Subsistence helps keep the voops going." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "For PvP you’ll also want to increase the recoil direction while also increasing the stability. The two most important factors for deep OHK on a fusion are zoom followed by stability. Because the Wizened Rebuke cannot roll rangefinder, the next best thing is to invest into stability to make sure that all the bolts hit. Under pressure also ensures that the little ammo you do get has the best benefits for each shot. Successful warm-up is one of my favorite perks for fusions to really make that second kill super easy to secure." Recommended MW - Stability.

(??? ???): Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 20. PvE first-choice roll for end-game add-clear. Unfortunately, you'll get no use from the Iron Banner-based origin trait, and the perks are a bit PvP orientated. Arrowhead Brake gets your recoil direction vertical, and Accelerated Coils helps with the charge time (you should still have enough damage to get a kill though), Particle Repeater helps tighten the spread or Ionized/Enhanced Battery gives more shots. Subsistence bypasses the Reload Speed penalty from Ionised Battery, and keeps you shooting until you run out of ammo, and Successful Warm-up reduces charge time without reducing damage so you can rip through beefier adds and majors. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 20. PvE backup roll for end-game damage to Majors - probably only worth keeping one in case there's a sandbox change which gives high-impact fusion rifles a bit more utility. Unfortunately, you'll get no use from the Iron Banner-based origin trait. Arrowhead Brake gets you recoil direction vertical, and Accelerated Coils helps with the charge time (you should still have enough damage to get a kill though), Particle Repeater helps tighten the spread or Enhanced Battery gives an additional shot. Successful Warm-Up is the only useful first-column trait for single-target damage and Vorpal Weapon provides a 15% damage boost against single targets. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.
